fee_notes: Royalty is 20% of Gross Revenues on new business (initial term policies) or 50% on renewal business, subject to Minimum Royalty. Minimum Royalty starts at $600/mo at month 6, escalating to $1,800/mo by month 121+. Corporate agent launches have higher minimums ($2,400-$6,000). Marketing Contribution up to 2% not currently required. Tech fee is $590/mo for first user, $420 each additional user, capped at 15% annual increase.
